thresholds.label: pressure reaches the static yield strength
thresholds.state: solid, flowing plastically wherever the load is uneven (the regime of the rest of magform)

thresholds.label: eddy-current skin starts to melt
thresholds.state: solid inside a molten eddy-current skin: the driven surface is a conducting liquid

thresholds.label: skin reaches its boiling point
thresholds.state: the skin reaches its boiling point within the pulse and starts to blow off as vapour

thresholds.label: skin completely vaporised
thresholds.state: the whole skin depth is vaporised and expands as a conducting plasma

thresholds.label: pressure equals the bulk modulus
thresholds.state: compressed to a fraction of its volume (megabar dynamic compression) and released as hot liquid or vapour

thresholds.label: pressure equals the atomic unit E_h/a0^3
thresholds.state: pressure-ionised: electron shells are crushed and the workpiece is a dense plasma, degenerate like the outer layers of a white dwarf as the pressure rises

thresholds.label: field equals the atomic unit B0
thresholds.state: where the field threads the matter, atoms are squeezed into needles along it and ordinary chemistry stops

thresholds.label: degenerate electrons turn relativistic (x = 1)
thresholds.state: white-dwarf matter: a relativistically degenerate electron gas denser than 1e9 kg/m^3

thresholds.label: field equals the QED critical field
thresholds.state: the field is beyond the quantum-electrodynamic critical value: an electron's cyclotron energy exceeds its rest energy and the vacuum itself is birefringent

thresholds.label: degenerate electrons reach the capture threshold
thresholds.state: degenerate electrons are forced into nuclei: 56Fe starts turning into 56Mn and the workpiece is being transmuted

thresholds.label: pressure equals the neutron-drip pressure
thresholds.state: neutrons drip out of the nuclei: the matter of a neutron star's inner crust

processes.forging: Electromagnetic forming as modelled in magform.eddy: the workpiece stays solid and flows where the pressure exceeds its flow stress.
processes.refractory_forming: Flow stress decides (magform.plasticity): tungsten needs roughly 2.5-3 GPa at room temperature.
processes.welding: Impact welding needs only 10-40 T (magform.welding); more field overshoots the weld window.
processes.synthesis: Below every static route to diamond or cubic boron nitride; a flyer-driven shock is marginal (magform.synthesis).
processes.densification: Pores collapse only above (2/3) sigma ln(1/f) and never bond cold (magform.porosity).
processes.containment: Compound steel walls hold about 2.5 GPa; no monolithic wall holds 4 GPa (magform.containment).

processes.forging: The driven surface melts or boils within the pulse, so the part is shaped through a liquid-metal skin and a shock: 'magnetohydrodynamic' finally describes it, and surface finish and dimensions are lost.
processes.refractory_forming: Strength stops mattering: the pressure is several to hundreds of times any flow stress, and tungsten fails the same way copper does, by losing its skin.
processes.welding: Flyers leave at several to tens of kilometres per second, far beyond any weld window: the joint is a hypervelocity impact crater.
processes.synthesis: Shock and ramp compression to tens and hundreds of gigapascals: diamond, lonsdaleite and other dense phases form in nanoseconds, as in flux-compression and Z-pinch experiments today. Recovering the product is the hard part.
processes.densification: Every pore is crushed, together with the surface of the part.
processes.containment: No structure contains the field statically: the pressure exceeds every material strength, so the source is destroyed each shot, as single-turn coils and flux-compression generators are.

processes.forging: The pressure exceeds the bulk modulus: the metal is shock-compressed to a fraction of its volume and comes back as hot liquid or vapour. No forged shape survives.
processes.refractory_forming: Refractory and soft metals behave alike: neither strength nor melting point registers against megabar pressure.
processes.welding: Flyers reach tens of kilometres per second and both parts vaporise on impact. Nothing is joined.
processes.synthesis: Planetary-core pressures, megabars and up: metallic hydrogen and other dense phases exist while the pulse lasts and not after.
processes.densification: Every pore is crushed, and so is the part.
processes.containment: No structure contains the field: it is held only by the inertia of an imploding liner, for microseconds.

processes.forging: The workpiece is a pressure-ionised plasma for the length of the pulse. There is no solid to forge.
processes.refractory_forming: No property of the solid survives; only density and atomic number distinguish one target from another.
processes.welding: Both parts are plasma before they meet.
processes.synthesis: Warm dense matter: every chemical bond is broken and whatever is recovered is quenched debris.
processes.densification: Porosity has no meaning in a plasma.
processes.containment: Inertial confinement only, for nanoseconds or less.

processes.forging: The piston pressure makes degenerate matter and the field, where it gets in, squeezes atoms into needles. Forging has no meaning.
processes.refractory_forming: Only nuclear charge and mass number distinguish materials.
processes.welding: Both parts are plasma before they meet.
processes.synthesis: 'Magnetic chemistry': where the field threads matter, atoms bind into chains along it with tens to hundreds of electronvolts per atom, but only while the field is on. As a piston it makes degenerate matter.
processes.densification: Porosity has no meaning in degenerate matter.
processes.containment: Nothing material holds the field; unheld it disperses in the light-crossing time. Nature's only static holder is a neutron star.

processes.forging: The sample becomes white-dwarf matter and explodes when the field lets go. Forging has no meaning.
processes.refractory_forming: Only nuclear charge and mass number distinguish materials, and above the capture threshold not even the charge is conserved.
processes.welding: Both parts are degenerate plasma before they meet.
processes.synthesis: Nuclear, not chemical, synthesis: degenerate electrons are forced into nuclei above each capture threshold and light elements fuse. The product is neutron-rich isotopes and a thermonuclear yield.
processes.densification: Porosity has no meaning in degenerate matter.
processes.containment: Nothing material holds the field; unheld it disperses in the light-crossing time. Nature's only static holder is a neutron star.

standoff.label: Comparable to the Earth's surface field (25-65 uT): compasses and magnetometers are disturbed
0.5 mT ('5 gauss') line for implanted electronic medical devices
Static-field exposure limit for the general public (400 mT)
Occupational static-field limit for head and trunk (2 T)
Occupational static-field limit for limbs (8 T)
Atomic unit of field (2.35e5 T): atoms are reshaped and ordinary chemistry stops
